roads.name: Roger Canyon Road
words: Properly twisty: 19 curves in 2.6 miles, about 7 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 7,510 to 8,084 ft, with 598 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 40 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.38 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
